title: This tool replaces Midjourney, Figma and Runway in one app
description:
Comment "MIORA" to get beta access 👆

New tool replaces Midjourney, Figma and Runway on a single canvas. Miora is an AI studio with creative agents, now in international beta. Images, video, interfaces and 3D all generated in one place. Agents read your canvas, reason through the task and call the right tools. Skills system, full crew of specialists for brand, illustration, UI/UX, video and 3D.

#miora #aitools #aidesign #aicreative #designtools
